messages:
sasha (AE): kicking this off — AcmeBank wants a POC to prove we can replace their current vendor without regressions. main asks: prompt parity, streaming behavior, and security Qs.
noah (SE): thanks. we should confirm exact API surface differences first (responses shape + streaming framing). do they use choices[] vs our outputs[]?
jessica (solutions): acme provided sample payloads. yes, vendor returns choices[0].text and stops with a final "is_done" flag. they also rely on chunk-level confidence metadata.
oliver (eng): streaming note: our streaming is SSE with event: data chunks that include token + role. can map easily but need to ensure their client-side parser tolerates our boundaries.
acme_cto: priority: no hidden truncation and identical stop-token semantics. can you guarantee same detokenization?
noah (SE): we can't guarantee exact byte-for-byte detokenization across models but we can run parity evals on their prompt set and report word-level diff rates.
sasha (AE): timeline? acme wants POC in 2 weeks to drive procurement.
jessica (solutions): proposed plan: week1 - ingest 2000 prompt/examples, wire compatibility shim, smoke tests for streaming and stops. week2 - side-by-side latency & output parity, security review.
frank (security): security Qs from acme: data residency, KMS integration, audit logs, SOC2 evidence, and private deployment option. do they want on-prem or VPC?
acme_cto: VPC preferred, KMS, and we need full audit trail for model inputs. also a signed DPA.
frank (security): we have VPC & KMS options. audit logs retained per enterprise add-on. i'll attach SOC2 report after NDA.
n oah (SE): for compatibility shim, here's a minimal curl example we can give them:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \n -d '{"prompt":"<their prompt>","max_tokens":256,"stream":true}'
```
Map response to vendor shape: transform outputs[0].content -> choices[0].text, add is_done when event: [DONE]. I'll put a mapping lambda in the POC repo.
jessica (solutions): pricing question: client expects like-for-like cost comps. they bill per 1k tokens + model multiplier. can we provide estimated monthly cost for their workload?
sasha (AE): acme shared 5M tokens/mo current. want estimate for our base model + quantized variant.
noah (SE): quick calc: base model ~ $0.003 per 1k tokens -> ~$15/mo, wait math... corrected: 5M tokens = 5,000 1k units -> 5,000 * $0.003 = $15. quantized variant might be 0.6x -> $9. I'll include network and reserved capacity uplift if they want Dedicated.
acme_cto: reserved capacity needed for SLA. what are our committed throughput numbers?
oliver (eng): Dedicated GPU pools can sustain their 99th P99 latency target of 300ms for small prompts at ~50 concurrent streams with 2x headroom. need final numbers after we run their load profile.
jessica (solutions): blockers: client insists on per-request replayability (full input retention) for audits. frank - retention policy ok?
frank (security): retention is configurable; we can enable full input logging in Private or Dedicated with encryption-at-rest and restricted access. legal will handle DPA.
sasha (AE): next steps: 1) share POC repo & mapping lambda (noah) 2) acme drops canonical prompt set + edge cases (acme_cto) 3) frank to start security paperwork 4) jessica to prep pricing + SLA stub. target demo end of next week.
noah (SE): I'll push initial mapping + a small evaluation harness that computes token-level diffs and a simple score: exact match rate, token edit distance, and hallucination flags. will include horizon for stop-token mismatches.
ijdeploy-bot: deploy scheduled: p-compat-shim -> staging at 2025-11-05T14:00Z
acme_cto: thanks, looking forward. one more: can you surface confidence per-chunk? we need it for our downstream ranking.
n oah (SE): we can expose model token logprobs in stream but that affects performance and cost — will flag in POC config.
jessica (solutions): noted. i'll include logprob toggle in the POC checklist.
sasha (AE): great, i'll send formal invite for weekly check-ins. if anything urgent ping me or noah. :thumbsup:
